MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council, Community Development Financing Authority,
  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency,
  Housing Authority, and Library Board of Trustees*

  October 14, 2019

An Adjourned Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Financing Authority,
the Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency, the Housing Authority, and the
Library Board of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor
Raths at 6:02 p.m., on October 14, 2019, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on October 11, 2019, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and Norman P.
Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Bucknum
  Council Member Kelley
  Council Member Sachs
  Mayor Pro Tem Goodell
  Mayor Raths

Absent:  None

Staff Present: Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Cheryl Dyas, Director of Administrative Services
  Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk

INVOCATION: Council Member Sachs

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Kelley

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Cathy Schlicht, M.V.: Voiced her concerns with the City Attorney’s response to her public
comments at the last meeting, regarding Measure D in 2010.

OLD BUSINESS

1.  Purchase of Casta Del Sol Public Golf Property for the Purpose of Preserving the Golf
  Course and Open Space

City Council Minutes  1  October 14, 2019
   City Manager Dennis Wilberg gave the staff report and City Attorney Bill Curley clarified
  questions regarding the City’s reserves.

  Cathy Schlicht, M.V.: Speaking on behalf of Gail Reavis and herself, she expressed concerns
  over the true costs that will be associated with the purchase and maintenance of the golf
  course. She questioned how the City will manage depleting reserves in the future and that the
  City will follow the lead of the Mission Viejo Country Club and sell a portion of the property
  to a developer in the future.

  Ingmar Forster, M.V.: Stated that he feels the City is rushing into the purchase of the golf
  course and expressed concerns over an asset that is going to continually lose money into the
  future and increase future budgets. He asked to see an updated appraisal.

  Gordy Hite, M.V.: Stated that he is in favor of the purchase but has concerns with the
  maintenance of the slopes at Casta del Sol Golf Course and the potential fire hazard. He asked
  that screens be installed at the tenth green to protect homes and vehicles from damage.

  The following residents spoke in favor of the purchase of the golf course citing quality of
  life, property values, open space and community benefits: Rebecca Moore, M.V.; Wally
  Lukanov, M.V.; Michael Conellan, M.V.; and Mark Schubert, M.V.

  Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Goodell, seconded by Council Member Bucknum, to adopt
  Resolution 19-37 Authorizing the Purchase of the Real Property Known as Casta Del Sol Golf
  Course and Related Real and Personal Property from American Golf Corporation, Approving
  the Execution of a Management Agreement Between the City Of Mission Viejo, California
  and AGC Management, and Taking all Actions Necessary and Convenient to Accomplish the
  Execution of Both the Purchase and Sale Agreement and Management Agreement, Including
  Executing Agreements, Adjusting Finances and Documenting the Foregoing as Necessary.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Goodell, Kelley, Sachs, and Mayor Raths
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

2.  Preparation of the Phase II Environmental Site Assessment for the Casta del Sol Golf
  Course and Adjacent Open Space

  Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services Keith Rattay gave the staff report.

  Motion made by Council Member Kelley, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Goodell, to approve
  the contract and authorize City staff to issue a purchase order to EKI Environment and Water,
  Inc. in an amount not to exceed $37,000.00.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Kelley, Sachs, Goodell, and Raths
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
City Council Minutes  2  October 14, 2019
 ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 7:15 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this session,
Mayor Raths adjourned the meeting to Monday October 22, 2019, at 5:00 p.m.

______________________________________________
Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of October 22, 2019

City Council Minutes  3  October 14, 2019
